newsitem.title: USA: Central and South West extends offer.
newsitem.headline: Central and South West extends offer.

text.p: Central and South West Corp said Thursday it has extended the expiration date of its offer to purchase shares of Central Power and Light Co 4.00 percent Series Cumulative Preferred Stock and 4.20 percent Series Cumulative Preferred Stock to 1000 CDT/1500 GMT Monday, April 28 to allow holders of those series to consider recent events involving Central Power.

The events include Central Power's final rate order issued on March 31 by the Public Utility Commission of Texas and shareholder approval of a proposal to eliminate limits on the utility's unsecured debt.

All other terms and conditions of the offer for Central Power's shares remain unchanged, Central and South West said, noting there have been 47,858 shares of the 4.00 percent and 54,164 shares of the 4.20 percent Series tendered.
The company also said it has waived a condition to its offer for West Texas Utilities Co's 4.40 percent Series Cumulative Preferred Stock and extended the offer to April 28.

The offer was previously conditioned upon the approval of an amendment to WTU's Restated Articles of Incorporation. Approval is no longer a condition to the offer to purchase West Texas shares, although tendering shareholders are still required to vote in favor of the proposal to validly tender their shares.
A special meeting of West Texas shareholders Wednesday in connection with the vote was adjourned and will be reconvened at 0945 CDT/1345 GMT April 28.
All other terms of the offer for West Texas shares remain unchanged, Central and South West said, adding 34,302 shares had been tendered.

The extension of the Central Power and West Texas tenders does not affec the company offers to purchase the preferred stock of Public Service Co of Oklahoma and Southwestern Electric Power Co which expired as scheduled Wednesday.
The Central Power and West Texas offers had also been scheduled to Wednesday. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
